title: HASTE: Hierarchical and Attribute-aware Supervision for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17368v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative recommendation models have shown promising results by representing items as semantic IDs and generating these IDs autoregressively. We introduce an approach showing that explicitly incorporating hierarchical and attribute-level supervision into generative recommendation can simultaneously improve training efficiency and long-tail recommendation performance. Existing approaches typically optimize semantic ID prediction with a standard causal cross-entropy objective, which does not explicitly exploit the hierarchical structure of semantic IDs and can require substantial training to learn effective item representations. Moreover, data-sparse tail items often suffer from poor representations due to limited supervision, resulting in weaker long-tail recommendation performance. translated_title: HASTE：面向生成式推荐的层次化与属性感知监督
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐模型通过将物品表示为语义ID并自回归地生成这些ID，已经展现出令人瞩目的效果。我们提出了一种方法，表明在生成式推荐中显式引入层次化和属性级监督，可以同时提升训练效率和长尾推荐性能。现有方法通常使用标准的因果交叉熵目标来优化语义ID预测，这种做法并未显式利用语义ID的层次结构，且往往需要大量训练才能学到有效的物品表示。此外，数据稀疏的长尾物品由于监督信息有限，常常难以获得良好的表示，从而导致长尾推荐性能较弱。我们通过HASTE（Hierarchical and Attribute-aware Supervision for generaTive rEcommendation，面向生成式推荐的层次化与属性感知监督）来应对这些挑战，这是一个统一的训练框架，它将……
tldr: HASTE提出一个统一的训练框架，通过在生成式推荐中显式引入语义ID的层次结构与属性级监督，同时提升了训练效率和长尾物品的推荐性能。
en_tdlr: HASTE is a unified training framework that explicitly incorporates hierarchical and attribute-level supervision into generative recommendation, simultaneously improving training efficiency and long-tail recommendation performance.
